ResearchProjectDef.label: detoxifier kidney module
ResearchProjectDef.description:
Manufacture a bionic module that, using a series of nanofilters, can rapidly remove a vast range of toxins from the blood, making it effective against environmental toxins, venoms, and injected poisons.
Modules can be self-installed into modified bionic or archotech parts, but can only be ejected by removing the part.

ResearchProjectDef.label: detoxifier lung module
ResearchProjectDef.description:
Manufacture a bionic module that uses microfilters to reduce the intake of environmental toxins, allowing the user to survive longer in polluted environments.
Modules can be self-installed into modified bionic or archotech parts, but can only be ejected by removing the part.
